items: Changing `EncSoldierImperialTemplate` 01FC5D also needs 12 records that use it, a leaf, or `EncSoldierSonsTemplate` 027498 (which takes `Stats` from it) as template but not for `Stats`: `EncGuardSonsTemplate` 0F6F38 (PC×1 [20–50], on *Common Stormcloaks*); the CC champions `ccFFBSSE001_NPC_ImperialChampion` 00086A · `…Backup` 000956 (PC×1.1 [15–45], on *Named Legion*), `ccFFBSSE001_NPC_StormcloakChampion` 00086C · `…Backup` 000957 (PC×1 [10–35]) and `ccFFBSSE001_KlijaBaseBountyFixChampion` 00095D (PC×1.25 [20–60]), all ccffbsse001-imperialdragon.esl (on *Named Stormcloaks*); the Sovngarde lost souls `MQ304LostSoulImperial` 091AF2 · `…2` 0173C1 (on the Nord leaves M01 and M03) and `MQ304LostSoulSons` 090A47 · `…2` 0173C0 · `…3` 0173C2 (PC×1.5 [3–20]; listed as never met on the *Imperial Legion* and *Stormcloaks* group pages); `dunBluePalaceBully` 09F851 (Anger, level 1, on World → *Haafingar Countryside*). `EncGuardImperialTemplate` 0F6F37 is a row of its own.

Changing the leaves (`LCharSoldierImperial`) also needs `CWFortSoldierImperialWounded` 0FD8AA (camp dressing, level 1): it takes its template from `CWSoldierImperial` 01B547, which draws them, without `Stats`; and `DLC1dunRedwaterDenAddictCWMaleCommander` 008D29:Dawnguard.esm (Imperial Deserter, level 1): it takes its template from `LCharSoldierImperialVoiceTypeMaleSoldier`, which draws the five MaleSoldier leaves, without `Stats`. Both are listed on the *Imperial Legion* group page as not enemies (on no census page).

Changing `EncGuardImperialTemplate` 0F6F37 also needs `MQ104Soldier01`–`04` 0A27CC · 0A4A3B · 101996 · 101997 (the Western Watchtower guards, PC×0.5 [2–25], on Guards → *Hold Guards*): they use the guard leaves M03, M08, M04, M09 as template but not for `Stats`; and, through `LCharGuardImperial`, `GuardWinterholdCollege` 105CBB (40, on Guards → *Other Guards*; template `LvlGuardImperial`), `MQ104SoldierSurvivor` 0B799D (1, on *Hold Guards*; template `LvlGuardImperialSingleVoiceTypeMaleNordCommander`) and `MQ301ImperialSoldier` 046EFC (PC×1.5 [3–20], starts dead; template `GuardWhiterunImperialPatrolDay`; listed as never met on *Imperial Legion*): each takes its template from a wrapper on that list without `Stats`.

The Imperial Wizard's level 6 is owned by `EncWarlock02TemplateFire` 045C5F (on Warlocks → *Pyromancers*). Changing it also needs `EncWarlock02TemplateBossFire` 0E0FBF (7, on *Warlock Bosses*), which uses it as template but not for `Stats`, and six CC records that take their template from `LvlWarlockElemental`, which draws it, without `Stats`: the Almsivi `ccASVSSE001_ElderDrevlan`, `…CaretakerIneril`, `…Priest02`, `…Priest03`, `…PriestDrureth` (on *Ghosts of the Tribunal*) and `ccBGSSSE013_GreenGuardian` 000845:ccbgssse013-dawnfang.esl.
The other rows: no other record keeps its own level (`MQ101ImperialSoldierCartDriver` uses `MQ101ImperialSoldier01` as template without `Stats`, but shares the Helgen row at the same level).

Every other record that looks like a row (the `CWFort*`, `CWSiege*`, `CWSoldierImperial*`, `MQ103` and `CW` mission wrappers, the garrison and hold guards, every `Lvl*` wrapper, and the rows moved here from Uncategorised: the Windhelm shifts, `CWPrisonerImperialB`/`C`, `GuardLoreiusFarmImperial`) carries `Stats` and follows its template or list.
